jobs.title: Senior Product Manager - Connect (x/f/m)
jobs.description: Set a new pulse for healthcare! We are looking for a Senior Product Manager to join the Doctolib Connect team in Amsterdam. Doctolib Connect is a secure medical communication app designed for healthcare professionals. More than 1M healthcare professionals use Doctolib Connect to discuss and coordinate patient care with colleagues, both within and beyond their organizational walls. Today, Doctolib Connect is the largest medical network in Europe. You'll work closely with a talented team to develop user-friendly products that meet market demands, such as tele-expertise or patient referral flows. What you'll do As a Senior Product Manager on the Doctolib Connect team, you will drive the development of products that strengthen care cooperation among healthcare professionals. Working at the heart of a cross-functional team, you will shape products that serve over 900,000 users across our network, combining a user-centric and data-driven approach with a focus on network effects and long-term impact. Success in this role means growing Doctolib Connect's network, launching products that achieve product-market fit, and delivering measurable value for both our users and the business. Your responsibilities include but are not limited to: Contributing to our product strategy to grow Doctolib Connect , identifying opportunities that strengthen the network and deliver user and business value Defining, shipping, and iterating on new products and features by analysing data, conducting user interviews, researching competitors, and leveraging cross-functional insights Continuously measuring adoption, impact, and network health, iterating as needed to achieve desired outcomes for your product and company goals Collaborating with engineering, design, and research teams to translate insights into hypotheses, experiments, and features that delight users and grow Doctolib Connect's network Working closely with cross-functional teams including sales, marketing, support, and company leaders

jobs.title: Clinical Data & Quality Manager (CDD 18 mois)
jobs.description: 🏨 The Company Resilience Care, a leading player in remote medical monitoring and a partner in clinical research, is a French company founded in 2021 with a single mission: to provide better care. Our company offers remote monitoring solutions in oncology, gastroenterology, and psychiatry, based on the collection of ePROs combined with AI technologies. These solutions rely on a monitoring platform for healthcare professionals—enabling the early detection of side effects for continuous and proactive care—and a mobile app for patients, empowering them to measure and manage their symptoms using tailored resources. Our solutions optimize patient care, continuously enrich our understanding of patients throughout their healthcare journey, and accelerate clinical research through the collection, structuring, and in-depth analysis of real-world data. Today, our solutions are deployed in routine care for 35,000 patients across more than 200 healthcare facilities, as well as within the framework of around twenty academic and industrial clinical trials. Through this, we put data at the service of healthcare and therapeutic innovation, driven by the ambition to enable every patient to benefit from personalized medicine. 📝 Your Role In a few words Within QARA, you oversee Good Clinical Practice compliance across Resilience’s sponsored studies and studies conducted with pharmaceutical partners. You combine clinical quality, data integrity and system qualification, working closely with the teams running studies and building data workflows. Your impact You help keep studies inspection-ready, data reliable and traceable, and compliance embedded in everyday work. Your role is to safeguard the framework and help teams apply it, rather than produce the data yourself. Your day-to-day work Oversee study GCP compliance, manage deviations and corrective and preventive actions (CAPAs), and conduct quality and Trial Master File (TMF) reviews. jobs.title: Senior Mechatronic System Architect | Medical Robotics (m/f/d)
jobs.description: Senior Mechatronic System Architect | Medical Robotics (m/f/d) Location: Maastricht, Aachen, and Eindhoven region, working mainly on-site with our development partner in Maastricht. Regular travel to Hamburg and to clinical sites, about 2 to 4 days per month. Reports to: CTO About the venture: ROB E ROB E is a Hamburg-based medtech startup and part of the NLC Health Ventures portfolio. We are developing a robotic system that holds and steers a standard transesophageal echocardiography (TEE) probe during structural heart interventions. Interventionalists get stable, reproducible echo views, and echocardiographers no longer have to stand next to the patient in the X-ray field. Our first-generation prototype has been used in a first-in-human study with published results. We are now developing the next generation from scratch as a fully compliant medical device for CE marking and FDA clearance. The team includes a CTO, a System Software Architect and a Head of Quality & Regulatory. The role You are the mechatronic design authority of ROB E. You own the system architecture, the hardware requirements and the technical decisions for the mechanics, drives, sensing and electronics of our robot. You work on site with our engineering development partner in the Maastricht area and steer their team on our behalf. This is a hands-on senior role: you design yourself, review the work of others and make sure the hardware is safe, verifiable and ready for design transfer. Responsibilities Define and own the mechatronic system architecture: robotic device, drives, force and torque sensing, real-time controllers, safety supervisor, power supply and the interface to commercial TEE probes. Translate user and system requirements into subsystem and interface specifications and keep them traceable through verification. Act as technical counterpart to our engineering development partner, from ideation, technology and part selection through design reviews and approval of design outputs. C

jobs.title: Engineering Manager
jobs.description: At Counterpart Health, we are transforming healthcare and improving patient care with our innovative primary care tool, Counterpart Assistant. By supporting Primary Care Physicians (PCPs), we are able to deliver improved outcomes to our patients at a lower cost through early diagnosis and longitudinal care management of chronic conditions. We're looking for an Engineering Manager to join our team. Our managers take on a player/coach role, balancing technical leadership, execution, and people management. The primary responsibility of Engineering Managers is to build and develop strong teams while ensuring high-impact results. We empower engineers to take ownership of problems and support them with mentorship, guidance, and business context. As an Engineering Manager, you will: Drive team impact by fostering high technical productivity and reliability. Cultivate a healthy, results-driven, and collaborative team culture. Represent the team in engineering-wide planning, initiatives, and processes. Partner withÂ Product Managers and Designers to shape our technical roadmap and solve problems that improve the patient and doctor experience. Set and communicate clear team objectives that align with Counterpart's company goals and roadmap. LeadÂ hiring, development, and retention efforts to build a high-performing team. You should get in touch if: You have technical leadership experience managing teams of 3+ engineers.Â You have a strong background in system design and proficiency in general-purpose programming languages such as Python, Ruby, Go, or Java. You have a track record of leading development projects while creating opportunities for others to grow into leadership roles. You have experience in fast-paced environments, making quick, strategic decisions under competing constraints. You have a proven ability to successfully deliver complex web applications and services. You are adaptable and able to work across various technical systems and concerns. Benefits Overview
